Name: Học Bơi Sài Gòn - Hồ Bơi CBD Quận 2
Note: Google-confirmed 06:00 open, good rating (4.5 on 41). 125 Đồng Văn Cống, at The CBD Premium Home - a 600+ m2 outdoor pool with a separate kids' area. Phone +84 796 783 225. Price is not published and the listing is branded as a swim school, so ask specifically for a single public entry rather than a course.

Name: Hồ bơi Kikyo Coffee
Note: Pool attached to a coffee shop at CC EHomeS, Đ. Đỗ Xuân Hợp - the setup suggests lounging rather than lap swimming, and a cafe is unlikely to be open at 06:30. No hours or price listed. Only 6 reviews.

Name: Hồ Bơi Thủ Thiêm
Note: Google says open all day Wednesday (closed Mondays), but a 24h pool listing is rarely accurate and there are only 3 reviews to corroborate anything. 269 Liên Phường, no phone listed. Do not ride out here on the strength of this listing alone.

Name: Hồ bơi Ánh Viên
Note: The safest bet on this list. 569 reviews - two orders of magnitude more evidence than anything nearer - confirming it is a genuine public pool, Olympic-standard, open 06:00-21:00, 523a Đ. Đỗ Xuân Hợp, phone +84 566 787 899. Price confirmed by multiple review sites. No monthly pass, pay per swim. Costs you ~2.5 km extra over the near options in exchange for near-certainty.

Name: Hồ Bơi Đông Sài Gòn
Note: Cheapest confirmed price with a solid review base (67). Google-confirmed 06:00-20:00. Đường Gò Cát, Long Trường, phone +84 909 108 882. Reviewers note the pool is large and not divided into lanes, which is good for free swimming but poor if you want to do timed laps.

Name: Hồ bơi Thảo Điền (Thao Dien Swimming Pool)
Note: Same street address as row 15 (8 Thảo Điền, An Khánh) - these are two Google listings for one venue, and their hours disagree (06:00-20:00 here vs 06:30-11:00 there). Only 5 reviews on this listing. Phone +84 786 945 678. Trust row 15's numbers over this one.
